name: richclay
description: Hyperclay-compatible DOM-first rich text editor built on Squire.
author: David Miranda

scripts.build:global: esbuild src/browser-global.js --bundle --loader:.css=text --format=iife --global-name=RichClayBundle --outfile=richclay.js --banner:js='/* richclay global build. Source lives in src/. Run npm run build to regenerate. */' --footer:js='window.RichClay = RichClayBundle.default;'
scripts.build:vendor: esbuild src/vendor-bundle.js --bundle --minify --loader:.css=text --format=iife --global-name=richclay --outfile=dist/richclay.min.js --banner:js='/* richclay self-contained vendor build (bundles Squire + DOMPurify) for hyperclayjs. Generated; do not edit. */'
scripts.build: npm run build:global && npm run build:vendor
